facts.fact: 三阳拽位：太阳异动（hours→seconds）——三星连珠成 lopsided triangle——「He's retaliating.」
facts.anchor: the Second Sun was rising, a matter of hours between sunrises shortened to seconds—an orbital phenomenon

facts.fact: 塔楼机关：Century of Eclipse 时 ost Krülins+祭司共建防御 Device——连接全部 lightspeed gates（三姊妹+Noctus 封门+Divine City）成菱形巨门——「Hence, this Device.」
符文辨认：黄铜板上有新刻 Conjuration glyphs——「Rian traced one of the glyphs: the hexagram that appeared when he used his new lightspeed ability. The symbol of aether.」
facts.anchor: Rian traced one of the glyphs: the hexagram

facts.fact: 记忆闪回：三星耀斑将穿门灼毁 Nexus——他记起 Bone Palace 顶持矛毁 Astrum 的自己——「Because of Phos. Because of him.」——父训反击：「You didn't have a choice. We were all doing what we had to in order to survive.」
facts.anchor: One that would pass through Phos’s portal and scorch Nexus to a ruin.

facts.fact: 菱形重瞄：吸收后 Rian 命 Edwin 拨杆仰角——自己以 lightspeed 拽起 Divine City 城门重新合菱——耀斑砸向神庙（facade 炸裂、portal 缩闭）。
名字灼伤：「The Second Sun was the smallest, yet he felt its heat the most. Honorable Risäl. A name that evoked judgment.」——谱名的政治学结账。
